fields.account:
Tidy up the mobile top bar

Drop the borders and backgrounds from the "here" and "leave" buttons on
mobile and trim the header padding, so the top bar takes less vertical
space. Tap targets are preserved via button padding.

---

Align mobile send button height with the input

Dropped the textarea's vertical padding so its intrinsic height no
longer exceeds the 44px min-height, leaving the send button and input
at the same height.

ended.reason: merged into main as 456f01c, "Merge pull request #19 … Claude/mobile topbar cleanup 2m b8v"

fields.answer: In the mobile breakpoint, the header buttons (#leave-btn, #who-toggle) drop border, background and min-height; their tap target is kept by padding 0.5rem 0.5rem. Header padding trimmed to 0.3rem 0.5rem (+ safe-area-inset-top). The join and send buttons keep min-height: 44px. The say textarea keeps min-height: 44px with padding 0.5rem 0.75rem, small enough that min-height wins over the intrinsic size, so textarea and send button line up.
fields.why: So the top bar takes less vertical space. Tap targets are preserved via button padding.

fields.says: On mobile the say textarea's vertical padding (0.7rem, from PR #13) makes its intrinsic height exceed the 44px min-height, so the send button and the input are not the same height.
